blockTypes: ModalShell: screen content in a popup, ends Close. ConfirmDialog: one short question. PageBanner: a standing message about the screen. ScreenHeading: the title and actions of a screen. BrowseToolbar: search, filters and add above a collection. Row: one record in a collection. FieldGroup: a titled group of fields. EmptyState: nothing to show, with the next action. StatTile: one headline figure.
